title: Diretor(a) de Marketing de Produtos
description:
A Omie está em busca de um(a) Head de Marketing de Produto (SaaS) para liderar a estratégia de posicionamento, crescimento e adoção do portfólio Omie e do seu ecossistema de soluções . Esta liderança terá papel central na construção da visão de mercado , na definição de narrativas e posicionamento de valor , e na conexão entre Produto, Marketing, Vendas, Growth, Sucesso do Cliente , além dos canais de distribuição (franquias e parceiros) e do canal contábil .

O escopo vai além do ritual clássico de Product Marketing: esta posição liderará também frentes complementares que ampliam o valor do ERP e sustentam a estratégia de “solução completa” para PMEs, incluindo:

  • marketplace/ecossistema de parceiros e soluções complementares ao Omie ERP;
  • Arquitetura: apoio técnico-consultivo para vendas enterprise/complexas;
  • Treinamentos: educação e capacitação em escala para clientes;
  • conexão com e-commerce e marketplaces;
  • frente de loja para varejo, restaurante e serviços;
  • Figital: integração do comércio físico e digital, unindo HUB + PDV como frente estratégica.

Essa pessoa será responsável por orquestrar essas frentes dentro de uma cadência consistente de Marketing de Produto , preservando a essência: ser a maior referência em conhecimento de produto e mercado , elevando o nível de sales enablement , posicionamento e percepção de valor para times internos, franqueados, contadores e clientes.

Principais atividades

Estratégia e Go-to-Market

  • Definir e liderar a visão de Marketing de Produto da Omie, conectando estratégia de negócio, mercado e execução;
  • Consolidar o portfólio (ERP + HUB + PDV + ecossistema) em uma narrativa clara, consistente e orientada por segmentos e necessidades.
  • Atuar como guardião(a) do posicionamento competitivo, categorias e mensagens-chave, orientando como a Omie gera vantagem competitiva.
  • Liderar estratégias de Go-to-Market end-to-end para produtos, integrações e aquisições, garantindo impacto em adoção, retenção e expansão.
  • Estruturar playbooks e modelos replicáveis por tipo de oferta e canal (vendas diretas, franquias, parceiros e contadores).
  • Garantir um modelo de GTM contínuo, sustentando performance ao longo do ciclo de vida do cliente.
  • Atuar em parceria com Vendas e Growth na construção de abordagens consultivas, orientadas a valor e escaláveis.
  • Traduzir soluções complexas em propostas claras para públicos executivos, comerciais e técnicos.

Ecossistema, Omie.Store e parcerias

  • Definir e liderar a estratégia da Omie.Store como frente de crescimento e geração de receita.
  • Estruturar governança de parceiros, critérios de priorização por segmento e iniciativas de co-marketing e co-selling.
  • Evoluir o marketplace para uma operação orientada a performance, escala e impacto comercial.

Arquitetura e vendas complexas

  • Liderar a frente de Arquitetura como braço estratégico de pré-vendas para deals complexos e contas enterprise.
  • Definir critérios de atuação, métricas de impacto e ativos reutilizáveis que ampliem escala e eficiência comercial.

Treinamentos e adoção

  • Liderar a estratégia de treinamentos conectando educação à adoção, retenção e valor percebido.
  • Estruturar trilhas por perfil e maturidade, com governança de conteúdo e métricas de impacto.

Figital ( Omie.HUB e Omie.PDV )

  • Sustentar o posicionamento estratégico das frentes Omie.HUB e Omie.PDV integradas ao ERP.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:

Se esse desafio faz sentido para você, vale a conversa.

All offers are contingent on successful completion of background checks, where permitted by law and as appropriate for the role. title: SAP GRC Senior Lead
description:
SAP GRC Senior Lead - Sao Paulo-Guararema

Mars is a family-owned business with over $50 billion in global sales, producing iconic brands like M&M’s®, SNICKERS®, TWIX®, PEDIGREE®, ROYAL CANIN®, and more. We operate in 80+ countries and are guided by our Five Principles: Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency, and Freedom. Join our 150,000 Associates in creating the world we want tomorrow.

Role Overview

Step into a high-impact leadership role as SAP GRC Senior Lead within Mars Global Services, our shared services division, and help shape the future of Mars Inc. through our Digital Core transformation. The Digital Core is Mars’ strategic initiative to modernize and unify our SAP landscape, leveraging S/4HANA on RISE to drive operational excellence, security, and compliance across our global business.

In this role, you will be responsible for the technical design, configuration, deployment, and ongoing operation of the SAP Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) system—an essential component of our Digital Core. The GRC Access Control (AC) system enables compliant user access processes, including access request provisioning, segregation of duties, and emergency access management (Firefighter), ensuring that only the right people have the right access at the right time.

Reporting to the SAP Security Senior Manager, you will collaborate closely with the Digital Core Security Team and Controls Team to ensure the GRC AC system is robust, scalable, and ready to support ongoing go-lives and deployments of user populations onto the Digital Core S/4HANA platform. You will also provide oversight and guidance for the steady-state operations of the GRC AC solution, helping Mars maintain the highest standards of security and compliance as we continue our transformation journey.

What are we looking for?

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience configuring SAP GRC Access Control, including MSMP workflow, BRF+ configuration, connector setup, rule set creation, and master data management
  • Proven experience implementing SAP security and GRC in S/4HANA transformation programs, with a strong understanding of GRC’s role in project lifecycles
  • Deep knowledge of SAP security role-based access controls, IT General Computer Controls, segregation of duties, sensitive access risks, and mitigating controls
  • Expertise in SAP identity management concepts such as user provisioning, access reviews, terminations, and single sign-on
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with SAP Basis, Identity, and Architecture teams to design integrated security solutions involving GRC
  • Experience with SAP Cloud Identity Access Governance (IAG) implementation is a plus
  • Strong communication skills to present complex GRC and security topics to both technical and business audiences

What will be your key responsibilities?

  • Own the end-to-end SAP GRC solution for the new S/4HANA on RISE Digital Core landscape
  • Design and enhance SAP GRC solution architecture to meet evolving business needs
  • Integrate SAP GRC with other systems and data sources to ensure seamless compliance management
  • Configure GRC Access Control workflows, rule sets, and security roles with precision
  • Manage GRC master data setup and conduct thorough testing aligned with S/4HANA transformation phases
  • Develop test plans, coordinate testing activities, and troubleshoot complex GRC issues
  • Create and maintain comprehensive GRC configuration and training documentation
  • Lead knowledge transfer sessions to Mars SAP Security AMS support teams to ensure smooth steady-state operations
  • Support SAP Security Project Team in planning and incorporating GRC tasks into S/4 implementation timelines and status reporting

What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles
  • Join a purpose-driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University
  • An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus

Mars is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. The company is pleased to provide such assistance, and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request.

title: Pre-Sales Consultant - Physical AI - Brazil
description:
We are seeking a technically fluent Pre-Sales Consultant to join our Physical AI Solutions team. In this role you will serve as the connective tissue between prospective customers and our delivery organization, translating complex robotics and autonomous-systems requirements into compelling, commercially viable solution proposals. You will work across our three core service lines ADAS Data Collection & Labeling, Robotics Data Collection & Labeling, Computer Vision data solutions to shape deals that accelerate the development of ADAS systems, vision-language-action (VLA) models, and sim-to-real transfer pipelines.

Key Responsibilities

• Solution Design & Scoping: Partner with prospects to understand their robotics model-training pipelines (VLM pre-training, VLA fine-tuning, RL alignment) and design data collection & labeling solutions that map to each stage.

• Technical Discovery: Lead technical discovery sessions covering sensor modalities (LiDAR, radar, camera, IMU), annotation taxonomies (3D bounding boxes, semantic segmentation, 6-DoF pose), and simulation requirements (Isaac Sim, Real2Sim asset creation).

• Proposal Development: Author technical proposals, SOWs, and RFP/RFI responses that articulate data pipelines, quality frameworks, tooling (e.g., proprietary labeling platforms), and delivery timelines.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Engineering, Delivery, and Product teams to validate feasibility, refine pricing models, and ensure smooth handoff from pre-sales to production.

• Market Intelligence: Stay current on robotics industry trends, foundation models, sim-to-real transfer, egocentric AI, 3D kinematics, reinforcement learning and feed insights back into go-to-market strategy.

• Customer Presentations & Demos: Develop and deliver tailored presentations, proof-of-concept demonstrations, and workshop sessions for technical and executive audiences.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years in a pre-sales, solutions engineering, or technical consulting role within data services, AI/ML, or robotics.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Strong understanding of autonomous driving and/or robotics data pipelines: sensor fusion, data collection at scale, annotation workflows, and quality assurance.

• Familiarity with machine learning model-training workflows, including data curation, labeling taxonomies, and evaluation metrics.

• Experience with at least two of: LiDAR point-cloud processing, camera/image annotation, 3D reconstruction, or simulation environments.

• Proven ability to translate complex technical requirements into clear proposals and commercial terms.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; comfortable presenting to both engineers and business teams.

Preferred Qualifications

• Direct experience with ADAS or L2–L5 autonomous driving programs at an OEM, Tier-1, or technology partner.

• Hands-on exposure to VLMs, VLAs, or sim-to-real transfer techniques.

• Familiarity with NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Omniverse, or equivalent robotics simulation platforms.

• Experience scoping egocentric data collection projects (AR/VR headsets, wearable sensors).

• Prior work at a Robotics, ADAS or AI training-data company.

• Master’s degree or higher in a relevant technical discipline.

What We Offer

• A front-row seat to the Physical AI revolution, working with leading robotics and autonomous vehicle companies worldwide.

• Competitive base salary.

• Comprehensive benefits package.

title: Growth Analyst | Internship
description:
O que a Liora faz

O Brasil tem um mercado de energia elétrica de R$ 300 bilhões por ano. A maioria das pessoas paga a conta todo mês sem questionar o valor, sem entender as opções e sem receber nada em troca além do serviço básico. A Liora muda essa equação.

A gente transforma a conta de luz em um produto financeiro — com cashback real, acesso a crédito e uma experiência que faz sentido para quem usa. O cliente economiza, a gente cresce, e o dinheiro que antes ficava parado numa conta de concessionária começa a circular de volta pra vida das pessoas.

Não é uma ideia. Em três meses de 2026 já dobramos de tamanho. A projeção é crescer 15x até dezembro. Temos backing de Canary, 17Sigma e 468 Capital — fundos que apostam em empresas com potencial de redefinir mercados inteiros. Se você quer entender como uma empresa assim é construída por dentro, essa vaga é o caminho mais curto.

Desafio

O mercado de energia é complexo, muito regulado e historicamente resistente à mudança. Isso significa que a maioria dos brasileiros ainda não sabe que pode escolher de onde vem sua energia — e os que sabem, muitas vezes não confiam em quem oferece.

Escalar num mercado assim exige mais do que anúncio bem feito — exige entender o que faz uma pessoa confiar, decidir e agir. Quem entrar nessa vaga vai trabalhar exatamente nisso: entender o que quebra a resistência do cliente, o que gera conversão de verdade e como transformar esse aprendizado num processo que escala.

Meta/Google Ads, Metabase, SQL, Python, N8N e Sheets são apenas ferramentas. O trabalho real é entender por que algo funciona — e saber replicar isso em escala sem perder a eficiência.

Por que essa vaga é diferente

A maioria das vagas "de marketing" te coloca pra promover posts, reportar métricas e esperar aprovação de três camadas hierárquicas. Essa não.

Você vai sentar do lado de quem toma decisão desde o primeiro mês. Vai ter acesso aos números reais da empresa — CAC, LTV, taxa de conversão por canal, por criativo, por oferta. Vai propor experimentos, defender sua lógica e ver o resultado aparecer em tempo real. É o tipo de exposição que a maioria das pessoas leva anos pra conseguir. Aqui você tem isso desde o começo.

Perfil que buscamos

Você não precisa ter experiência em marketing, em energia ou em nenhuma área específica. Você precisa:

  • Gostar de números de verdade — não só de ler dashboard, mas de questionar o que está por trás dele.
  • Conseguir pegar um problema confuso e quebrar em partes que podem ser testadas
  • Ter mais curiosidade do que certeza, e mais disposição pra errar rápido do que medo de estar errado
  • Ser ambicioso no sentido real da palavra — alguém que pensa em construir algo grande, não só em ter um emprego que paga bem

Se você está na faculdade, querendo mais do que aula teórica, e quer entender como uma empresa de verdade cresce na prática — essa vaga é pra você!

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
Discover Peliplat

Peliplat is an online community made by film lovers, for film lovers! We’re evolving the way film enthusiasts and content creators interact; transforming movie watching into a shared, interactive social experience .

With the launch of our interactive online screening platform , Peliplat is no longer just a place to talk about films; it’s where audiences come together to discover, watch, and experience cinema in real time . From Virtual Screening Rooms and live co-watching events to fan driven discussions and creator-led sessions, we’re building a new kind of digital cinema for the next generation.

On Peliplat, film aficionados can share insights, express their reactions, host screenings, and collaborate on the creation of the next big hit. While our primary focus has been the Latin American market, we are now expanding globally, positioning ourselves as the home of movie buffs and a community shaping the future of cinema .

Join us and be part of this new era of interactive cinema!

What Will Your Next Role Look Like?

As our Marketing Specialist, you will lead the development and execution of growth strategies that position Peliplat as a must-try platform for film lovers.

You will create campaigns that spark curiosity, drive engagement, and fuel viral growth—leveraging influencers, community dynamics, and storytelling to scale our global presence.

Key Responsibilities

Growth Strategy & Execution

  • Develop and execute growth strategies to drive installs, engagement, and retention
  • Identify and scale viral loops, referral systems, and community-driven growth mechanisms
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product and Content teams to align growth initiatives

Campaign Development

  • Lead end-to-end campaign execution (e.g., “Watch With (Name),” themed screenings, launch campaigns)
  • Translate product features and content into compelling, user-facing narratives
  • Build campaigns that drive both immediate traction and long-term brand equity

Influencer & Partnership Strategy

  • Collaborate with influencers, creators, and partners to expand reach and credibility
  • Design and execute influencer programs and activation strategies
  • Identify high-potential creators and turn them into growth drivers for the platform

Performance & Optimization

  • Track and analyze campaign performance across key metrics (acquisition, engagement, retention)
  • Continuously test, iterate, and optimize campaigns based on data and insights

Who You Are

  • A builder mindset: you don’t just plan, you execute, test, and scale
  • Strong creative instinct paired with data-driven decision making
  • Deep interest in entertainment, culture, and digital communities
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and moving quickly in a fast-paced environment
  • Highly proactive, resourceful, and results-oriented

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field
  • 3–7 years of experience in marketing, growth, or brand strategy
  • Proven track record of driving user acquisition and campaign performance
  • Experience in LATAM markets is strongly preferred
  • Strong analytical, communication, and execution skills

Our Culture

As Peliplat evolves into a global, product-driven company, our culture is not just something we believe in; it’s how we execute.

We are building more than a platform; we are shaping the home of movie buffs and redefining cinema as a shared, interactive experience . This requires a team that thinks beyond traditional models, moves with urgency, and creates value through both creativity and strategy.

Our culture is rooted in people who don’t just operate within systems, but who build, challenge, and scale them .

  • Ownership — Think Like a Builder
  • Strategic Hustle — Create Value Beyond Budget
  • Problem-Solving — Decode Complexity
  • Result Oriented — Drive Real Impact
  • Market Intelligence — Know the Game
  • Passion for Cinema & Community — Build What You Believe In

title: Account Manager

About Us

If you're someone who genuinely loves building relationships, thrives on keeping things organized and on track, and takes pride in making clients feel like they're in the best hands, we want to hear from you.

title: Especialista em Tecnologia - Segurança da Informação e IA
description:

Acreditamos na igualdade de oportunidades e um ambiente plural. Todos os candidatos serão considerados em nossos processos, independente de gênero, idade, etnia, cor, credo, orientação sexual e deficiência.

  • Habilidades em análise de riscos, gestão de incidentes e resposta a emergências;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe, comunicar-se efetivamente e liderar projetos;
  • Pensamento crítico, resolução de problemas e atenção aos detalhes.

Diferenciais:

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação - Pleno
description:

Esse profissional será responsável por administrar e evoluir soluções de segurança, identificar e analisar riscos e vulnerabilidades, monitorar continuamente os ambientes e atuar na resposta a incidentes cibernéticos. Sua atuação será fundamental para garantir a proteção dos dados, a integridade dos sistemas e a continuidade dos serviços críticos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Administrar e monitorar soluções de segurança e appliances de rede;

title: Business Development Manager, Brazil
description:
About ASTERRA

ASTERRA is the global leader in satellite-based infrastructure intelligence. The company utilizes L-band Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data and proprietary algorithms to detect soil moisture and underground leaks. This technology empowers water utilities, government agencies, and infrastructure sectors- including roads, railways, dams, and levees- to make data-driven decisions.

Brazil is a Level 1 Platinum Territory and represents one of ASTERRA’s most strategic markets within LATAM. The Brazilian water and wastewater sector presents significant opportunities for infrastructure monitoring and leak detection solutions, making the territory a key growth engine for the company.

About the Job

ASTERRA is seeking a Business Development Manager for Brazil to lead and expand the company’s commercial presence in the Brazilian market.

In this role, you will own the development of ASTERRA’s partner ecosystem and market strategy across Brazil. You will work closely with resellers, integrators, consulting firms, and key infrastructure stakeholders to drive new business opportunities and expand existing accounts.

This is a field-oriented role combining strategic leadership with hands-on operational execution . The role requires building strong relationships with partners and water utilities, managing complex sales cycles, supporting project implementation, and ensuring successful delivery and results for customers. The position requires strong autonomy, analytical thinking, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in Israel and internationally.

Key Responsibilities

Territory Strategy & Ecosystem Development

  • Define and execute the Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy for Brazil .
  • Map and analyze the Brazilian infrastructure and water utility ecosystem to identify and recruit strategic partners.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with resellers, system integrators, consulting firms, and service providers operating in the water and infrastructure sectors.
  • Translate local market insights into actionable growth plans to win new customers and expand existing accounts.

Commercial Leadership & Sales Execution

  • Lead discovery meetings, opportunity development, and commercial negotiations with partners and end customers.
  • Build executive-level relationships with key stakeholders within water utilities, infrastructure operators, and partner organizations.
  • Drive collaborative co-selling activities with partners while coordinating internal resources to support deal progression.
  • Develop and maintain a strong partner-generated sales pipeline aligned with territory revenue goals.

Partner Enablement & Ecosystem Management

  • Support partner onboarding, commercial enablement, and product training.
  • Ensure partners understand ASTERRA’s technology, value proposition, and use cases.
  • Monitor partner activity and performance, focusing on strengthening relationships with high-performing partners while optimizing the partner portfolio.
  • Provide training and knowledge-sharing to partners, customers, and ecosystem stakeholders.

Project Oversight & Value Realization

  • Maintain a hands-on approach to project execution, supporting customers and partners throughout project delivery and implementation.
  • Monitor project performance, results, and customer outcomes to ensure successful adoption of ASTERRA’s solutions.
  • Work proactively with partners and customers to improve results, align expectations, and identify opportunities for expansion.
  • Maintain strong post-sale engagement to support upselling and long-term customer relationships.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, and Operations teams to align global resources with local market opportunities.
  • Share field insights and market intelligence to support product development and strategic planning.
  • Maintain effective communication with international teams while operating remotely across time zones.

What You’ll Need

Experience

  • 5-7+ years of experience in Channel Sales, Business Development, or Commercial roles .
  • Direct experience in the water, wastewater, utilities, or infrastructure sectors in Brazil is required .
  • Strong knowledge of the Brazilian water and wastewater market and familiarity with public water utilities.

Network & Market Knowledge

  • Existing professional network within water utilities, infrastructure operators, government agencies, or related sectors is highly desirable.

Territory Management

  • Proven experience managing a field territory in Brazil and driving commercial growth through partners and direct engagement.

Languages

  • Native or fluent Portuguese and professional English are mandatory.
  • Spanish is an advantage.

Commercial & Strategic Skills

  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales processes involving multiple stakeholders and partners.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate technical solutions into business value.

Remote Collaboration

  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining strong collaboration with international teams, particularly with colleagues based in Israel.

Travel

  • Willingness to travel across Brazil as required.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Revenue: Achievement of quarterly and annual revenue targets generated through partners and direct sales.
  • Pipeline Health: Development and maintenance of strong pipeline coverage within the territory.
  • Partner Development: Growth in the number of active and productive partners in Brazil.
  • Retention & Expansion: Customer retention and expansion through upselling and cross-selling opportunities.

Why Join us?

  • Impact : Work with breakthrough satellite-based SAR technology that helps conserve critical resources and protect infrastructure worldwide.
  • Ownership Culture : Join a high-performance organization built on accountability, collaboration, and customer obsession.
  • Strategic Market : Lead ASTERRA’ s expansion in one of the company’s most important global markets.
  • Growth Opportunity : Be part of a scaling technology company turning advanced satellite data into real-world impact.
  • Compensation : Competitive compensation package including performance-based incentives.

*Please ensure that your resume is submitted in English.

title: Arquiteto de CRM Especialista (Salesforce & Dynamics)

Flexibilidade e desejo de aprender: Capacidade de ser flexível e se adaptar a novas tecnologias rapidamente, além de desejar aprender coisas novas para trazer propostas e soluções inovadoras.

Habilidades analíticas: Analisar dados e problemas de forma rápida e eficiente para encontrar soluções criativas para problemas complexos.

Aptidão para resolução de problemas: Possuir excelentes habilidades de resolução de problemas e a capacidade de pensar fora da caixa para quebrar problemas complexos.

Gerenciamento de tempo: Gerenciar o tempo de forma eficaz é essencial para o Arquiteto de Soluções. Freqüentemente, vários fluxos de trabalho estão sendo executados simultaneamente com a necessidade de priorizar tarefas para cumprir marcos e prazos.

Nosso jeito de agir é o nosso principal diferencial, por isso, para fazer parte do time procuramos pessoas que sejam curiosas, estejam abertas à mudanças, busquem continuamente novas

soluções e alternativas, mantenham atitudes pró-ativa, compreendam o objetivo a ser alcançado com qualidade e pontualidade e que sejam colaborativas, promovendo feedbacks constantes e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento e aprendizado individual e coletivo.

Diferenciais:

● Mindset de agilidade e experiência em ambientes com governança de TI compartilhada.

Localidade da posição:

São Paulo/SP

Oferecemos autonomia, metas claras e um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, onde os profissionais têm oportunidade para interagir com diferentes tecnologias, participar de todos os tipos de projetos, trazer novas ideias e de trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil e (por que não?) do mundo. Além disso, somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil segundo a Great Place to Work e uma das 10 empresas que mais cresce no país há 3 anos consecutivos, segundo o Anuário Informática Hoje.

Quais são nossos valores?

title: User Operations Expert
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a User Operations Expert – User Growth to join our Growth team in São Paulo. This role will be responsible for driving end-to-end customer growth strategy , focusing on user acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention .

You will play a critical role in building a scalable and sustainable user growth engine , combining data insights, operational excellence, and cross-functional collaboration to unlock new growth opportunities and maximize user lifetime value.

Key Responsibilities

1. User Growth Strategy & Execution

  • Design and execute customer growth strategies across the full funnel (acquisition → activation → retention → loyalty)
  • Develop a structured growth framework based on user lifecycle and behavioral insights
  • Build and continuously optimize a sustainable growth engine aligned with business goals

2. User Segmentation & Retention Strategy

  • Develop and manage a robust user segmentation model (e.g., new, active, dormant, high-value users)
  • Design targeted engagement and retention initiatives to increase stickiness and frequency
  • Drive lifecycle marketing strategies to improve user contribution, loyalty, and long-term value

3. Channel Expansion & Acquisition Optimization

  • Identify and test new user acquisition channels (organic, paid, partnerships, referrals, etc.)
  • Optimize channel performance through continuous experimentation and A/B testing
  • Stay ahead of emerging traffic trends and growth tactics to reach high-quality users

4. Data Analysis & Product Collaboration

  • Analyze user behavior data to identify growth opportunities across acquisition, engagement, and retention
  • Translate insights into actionable growth initiatives and experiments
  • Partner closely with Product and Tech teams to enhance user experience and product features that drive growth

5. Cross-functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Data, and Tech teams to align priorities and resources
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives to ensure efficient execution of growth projects
  • Act as a key stakeholder in growth-related decision-making and roadmap planning

Requirements

  • Proven experience in User Growth, User Operations, Growth Marketing, or similar roles (preferably in B2C / marketplace / tech environments)
  • Strong understanding of growth frameworks (AARRR, lifecycle management, retention loops)
  • Demonstrated ability to build and scale user growth strategies from data insights
  • Advanced analytical skills ( SQL or strong data analysis capability is a plus )
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Marketing teams
  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to drive initiatives end-to-end in a fast-paced environment
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese

Job Purpose:

We are looking for a Field Specialist to join our Brazil team. This role will shadow pharmaceutical representatives for the day and prepare a report based on observations made while working with the representative as they interact with their customers. The position is appointment based, depending on the size of the project and number of field days required. The position would be suitable for someone looking for project-related part-time work that leads to a long-term collaboration.

  • Contacting sales representatives to arrange a shadowing day in the field
  • Observing interactions between sales representatives and customers without disrupting their day (primarily face to face)
  • Conducting a 60–90-minute interview with the sales representative during the field day
  • Submitting structured reports (workbooks), translated into English, after each day in the field based on observations made within 24-48 hours of field visit
  • Attending a 30-60 min online session prior to each project to understand the project objectives and share feedback
  • Participate in project debrief calls and potentially provide feedback to assist in the development of final recommendations

Person Specification:

  • Experience in sales, marketing or market research within Pharmaceutical or Healthcare industries
  • Fluent command of Portuguese and English (written and oral)
  • Bachelor’s degree – marketing, science, or data focus is preferred
  • When working on a project, have 1-3 days availability during the week
  • Flexibility to work from morning to evening
  • Flexibility to travel within the country
  • Strong attention to detail and excellent listener
  • Confident user of Microsoft Excel

Opportunity:

  • Work with a successful and well-established company with an enviable growth trajectory
  • Working with 29 out of top 30 pharmaceutical companies globally
  • Great flexibility in managing the workload and opportunity to travel within the country
  • Structured and on-going training system and working with strong management team

If you would like to apply for this position, please submit your CV in ENGLISH .

About STEM:

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação Pleno
description:

Analista de Segurança da Informação Pleno

Buscamos um Analista Sênior em Segurança da Informação para atuar como guardião da resiliência tecnológica da empresa. Alguém com visão holística, que consiga equilibrar práticas tradicionais de defesa com estratégias modernas, automatização e governança sólida. Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida em Segurança da Informação (nível sênior).
  • Domínio em gestão de riscos, incidentes e vulnerabilidades.
  • Conhecimento avançado de redes, protocolos, arquitetura e modelos de segurança.
  • Experiência com Azure (Microsoft M365) e AWS em contexto de segurança.
  • Vivência com ferramentas SIEM, EDR/XDR e soluções de proteção de endpoint.
  • Entendimento de LGPD e compliance regulatório aplicável.
  • Experiência com IAM, políticas e controles de acesso.
  • Capacidade de escrever e manter políticas, processos e padrões corporativos.
  • Boa comunicação para se relacionar com tecnologia e negócio sem ruído.

Competências Comportamentais:

  • Proatividade e senso de urgência.
  • Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe.
  • Organização e foco em resultados.
  • Capacidade analítica e orientação a solução de problemas.

Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar iniciativas de segurança, garantindo aderência a normas, políticas internas e frameworks de mercado (NIST, CIS, LGPD).
  • Conduzir avaliações de risco, análises de vulnerabilidade e propor planos de mitigação eficazes.
  • Realizar Patch Management no Ambiente afim de mitigar vulnerabilidades
  • Coordenar investigações e resposta a incidentes de segurança de ponta a ponta.
  • Desenvolver, revisar e reforçar políticas, padrões e procedimentos de SI.
  • Monitorar eventos e ameaças em ferramentas de SIEM/SOC, apoiando times operacionais e times de infraestrutura.
  • Realizar hardening de sistemas, aplicações, redes e ambientes cloud.
  • Gerir identidade e acesso (IAM), incluindo melhores práticas de MFA, RBAC e segregação de funções.
  • Operar e otimizar ferramentas de segurança: EDR/XDR, WAF, DLP, CASB, Zero Trust e Firewall (IPS e IDS)
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, acompanhando planos de ação.
  • Influenciar cultura de segurança, treinando e sensibilizando áreas de negócio.
  • Avaliar tecnologias emergentes e propor evoluções arquiteturais e de governança.

Diferenciais:

  • Certificações: CompTIA Security+.
  • Experiência com Zero Trust, SASE, DevSecOps e segurança em pipelines CI/CD.
  • Conhecimento de frameworks SRE voltados à segurança.
  • Experiência com automação e scripts (PowerShell, Python, Bash).
  • Atuação prévia em ambientes de fintech, financeiro ou empresas altamente reguladas.

Process Optimization & Innovation

Required Qualifications

Preferred Technical Background

description:
BSI’s Assurance division is hiring a LATAM Marketing Manager to own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy across Latin America with a primary focus on Mexico.

In this role, you will translate global strategy into high-impact, localized programs that fuel pipeline and revenue across System Certification, Training, and ISA, while leading our regional Center of Excellence (CoE) for campaign development, design, and digital execution.

You’ll also serve regionally as a Theme Lead for Quality & Mobility, setting the bar for messaging and integrated campaigns used across the Americas.

If you thrive in a matrixed, fast-paced environment and can flex from strategy to hands-on execution, this role is for you!

What you’ll own:

  • LatAm GTM leadership: Build and deliver the marketing plan for Latin America (with Mexico emphasis) aligned to commercial targets and sector priorities.
  • Localization that wins: Adapt global/regional campaigns to local language, culture, regulation, and buyer behavior.
  • Partner with the business: Collaborate effectively with Sales and Training to shape marketing strategies that move pipeline and revenue.

How you’ll lead:

  • Operational excellence: Drive clarity, workload management, and accountability using project tools (e.g., Workfront); uphold brand, compliance, and governance standards.

How you’ll execute:

  • Full-funnel, integrated campaigns: Orchestrate email, web, SEO/SEM, paid media, social, events/webinars, and ABM to create demand and accelerate conversions.
  • Digital & demand-gen mastery: Increase engagement, improve targeting, and optimize journeys; manage lead workflows in Salesforce and Pardot (segmentation, routing, nurture).
  • Budget ownership: Plan, allocate, and track the LATAM marketing budget for maximum ROI.
  • Vendor leadership: Manage local partners (design, translation, event logistics, media buying) to deliver on brief, on brand, on budget.
  • Brand & governance: Ensure every asset meets BSI’s standards and regional regulatory requirements.

How you’ll measure success:

  • Performance & analytics: Track KPIs and attribution, maintain CRM hygiene, and partner with data teams on ROI reporting.
  • Optimize in real time: Use funnel insights to test, learn, and iterate maximizing conversion and marketing-influenced revenue.

Regional Theme Leadership (Quality & Mobility):

  • Set the bar regionally: Define positioning, content strategy, and integrated campaigns for Quality & Mobility.
  • Scale best practices: Align global messaging with LATAM needs; enable knowledge-sharing and consistent activation across countries.

What you bring:

  • Strategic clarity & executional rigor: You turn business goals into actionable programs that deliver measurable impact.
  • Proven demand gen: History of campaigns that drive MQLs, pipeline, and conversion in complex B2B environments.
  • LATAM expertise: Deep understanding of Mexico and broader LATAM buyer behavior, channels, and regulatory nuances.
  • Localization mastery: You have experience in tailoring global content/messages for maximum regional relevance.
  • Relationship builder: Confident collaborator across Sales, Training, and global teams.

Diferenciais:

  • Certificações em redes, como CCNA ou Network+;
  • Experiência na administração de servidores Linux e Windows;
  • Conhecimento em frameworks e padrões de segurança, como NIST, CIS, MITRE ATT&CK e ISO 27001.

title: Usuário Final do Arquiteto de Domínio
description:
Junte-se a uma das maiores empresas de serviços de TI do mundo! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira!

Por que se juntar à TCS? Aqui na TCS, acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença. Estamos buscando um Usuário Final do Arquiteto de Domínio , que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira, em um contrato CLT, remoto .

Descrição do cargo:

O Arquiteto de Domínio – Computação do Usuário Final tem a responsabilidade de projetar, governar e evoluir as arquiteturas que suportam a experiência do usuário final nas operações da Brasil e Canadá. Isso inclui dispositivos, desktops, laptops, dispositivos móveis, virtualização, colaboração, suporte remoto e soluções de espaço de trabalho digital. O objetivo é oferecer ambientes modernos, seguros e eficientes, alinhados às necessidades dos usuários, garantindo alta disponibilidade, facilidade de uso e integração com plataformas corporativas.

Esse profissional trabalhará colaborativamente para implementar soluções inovadoras que promovam produtividade, segurança, automação e mobilidade, respeitando a governança internacional e os padrões de segurança, e com uma visão clara de transformação digital centrada no usuário.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Definir e manter arquiteturas de ponta a ponta para ambientes de Computação do Usuário Final (EUC), abrangendo dispositivos físicos, virtuais, móveis, desktops virtuais (VDI), BYOD e de colaboração.
  • Estabelecer padrões e estruturas para provisionamento, gerenciamento e segurança de dispositivos, incluindo políticas de acesso, controle de identidade (IAM), criptografia e proteção contra ameaças.

  • Colabore com TI, segurança, negócios e operações para alinhar as demandas e promover a melhor experiência do usuário final.
  • Promover uma governança eficaz, cumprindo as regulamentações globais (LGPD, GDPR, PIPEDA) e as políticas internas.
  • Produzir documentação completa, guias, planos de contingência, treinamentos e melhores práticas para equipes de apoio e operações.
  • Participe de fóruns, workshops e projetos de inovação para manter o ambiente tecnológico alinhado com as tendências globais.

Requisitos e Competências

Requisitos Essenciais (Habilidades Técnicas)

  • Ensino superior em Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas similares.
  • Sólida experiência (mínimo 8 anos) em arquitetura, gestão e inovação do ambiente de Computação para Usuários Finais, em empresas globais ou setores altamente complexos.
  • Conhecimento avançado em plataformas e ferramentas EUC: Microsoft 365, Windows Desktop, macOS, VDI (Citrix, VMware Horizon), MDM (Intune, MobileIron), ferramentas de colaboração (Teams, Zoom).
  • Expertise em segurança de dispositivos, zero trust, gerenciamento de identidade e acesso (Azure AD, Okta), criptografia, proteção de endpoints, automação e monitoramento.
  • Experiência com ambientes de trabalho híbridos e remotos, suporte técnico avançado e estratégias para maximizar produtividade e segurança.
  • Inglês fluente para comunicação técnica global, português avançado para alinhamento Brasil-Canadá.

Habilidades Interpessoais

  • Capacidade de se comunicar de forma clara e eficaz com equipes técnicas, usuários finais e executivos.
  • Habilidades analíticas, orientação para soluções e inovação centrada no usuário.
  • Liderança, influência e capacidade de trabalhar em ambientes multiculturais e colaborativos.
  • Proatividade, organização e foco em entregar valor contínuo.

Diferenciais / Bom ter:

  • Certificações em Gestão de Projetos (PMP, Prince2) ou Gestão de Mudanças (PROSCI Certified Change Practitioner).
  • Experiência específica no setor de mineração, transformação digital ou grandes iniciativas globais.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas digitais para Gestão de Mudanças e comunicação colaborativa (MS Teams, SharePoint, Yammer, etc.).

Habilidades e Entregáveis Esperadas, Impacto:

  • Arquitetura sólida e escalável do ambiente de computação para usuários finais para, Brasil e Canadá.
  • Modernização e automação dos espaços de trabalho, com melhorias substanciais na experiência do usuário final.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Discover Peliplat

Peliplat is an online community made by film lovers, for film lovers! We’re evolving the way film enthusiasts and content creators interact; transforming movie watching into a shared, interactive social experience .

With the launch of our interactive online screening platform , Peliplat is no longer just a place to talk about films; it’s where audiences come together to discover, watch, and experience cinema in real time . From Virtual Screening Rooms and live co-watching events to fan driven discussions and creator-led sessions, we’re building a new kind of digital cinema for the next generation.

On Peliplat, film aficionados can share insights, express their reactions, host screenings, and collaborate on the creation of the next big hit. While our primary focus has been the Latin American market, we are now expanding globally, positioning ourselves as the home of movie buffs and a community shaping the future of cinema .

Join us and be part of this new era of interactive cinema!

What Will Your Next Role Look Like?

As Marketing Manager, Brazil , you will lead the development and execution of Peliplat’s local marketing strategy , driving user growth, engagement, and brand positioning in the Brazilian market.

This is a hands-on strategic role : you will not only execute campaigns but also define how Peliplat wins in Brazil —from influencer strategy and community growth to viral campaigns and cultural positioning.

You will work closely with global teams (Product, Content, BD) while acting as the local market expert , ensuring our product and messaging resonate deeply with Brazilian audiences.

Responsibilities

Market Strategy & Growth Ownership

  • Define and execute Peliplat’s go-to-market strategy for Brazil , aligned with company growth targets (downloads, DAU, retention, subscriptions), with emphasis on Mobile Application Development.
  • Localize global strategies to fit the Brazilian audience behaviour, trends, and cultural nuances
  • Identify growth opportunities through viral loops, partnerships, and community-driven mechanics
  • Act as the key voice of the Brazilian market internally

User Acquisition & Campaign Execution

  • Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns , focusing on organic and viral growth channels
  • Develop referral programs, co-watching campaigns, and “watch with friends” mechanics
  • Collaborate with paid media teams (when applicable) to optimize performance campaigns
  • Continuously test and iterate growth strategies based on performance data

Influencer & Creator Strategy

  • Build and manage relationships with Brazilian influencers, film critics, and content creators
  • Identify and onboard creators to host Virtual Screening Rooms and co-watching events
  • Develop scalable influencer programs (from top-tier KOLs to micro-creators)
  • Leverage the “100% revenue to creators” model to attract and retain talent

Community & Event Marketing

  • Drive adoption of Virtual Screening Rooms as core user behaviour
  • Plan and execute high-impact events (e.g., “Watch with (Influencer)”, themed screenings, premieres)
  • Foster a strong community culture through interactive campaigns and social engagement
  • Collaborate with operations teams to ensure successful event execution

Content & Social Media Strategy

  • Define content direction for Brazil across TikTok, Instagram, and other relevant platforms
  • Identify viral content formats (reaction videos, co-watching clips, film discussions)
  • Collaborate with content and ops teams to turn in-app moments into shareable external content
  • Ensure consistent brand voice and cultural relevance

Data-Driven Optimization

  • Track and analyze key metrics: installs, activation, retention, DAU/MAU, engagement
  • Use insights to refine campaigns, content, and user journeys
  • Identify behavioral patterns and optimize funnel performance
  • Report on market performance and recommend strategic adjustments

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product to provide feedback on user experience and localization needs
  • Collaborate with BD and Content teams on creator partnerships and programming
  • Align with global marketing while advocating for Brazil-specific strategies
  • Support long-term brand building and market expansion plans

Qualifications

  • 5–8+ years of experience in marketing, growth, or community roles , ideally in tech, media, or entertainment
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian digital landscape , including social media and influencer ecosystems
  • Proven experience driving user growth, engagement, or community-building initiatives
  • Experience working with influencers, creators, or content-driven platforms
  • Analytical mindset with experience using data to drive decisions
  • Fluent in Portuguese (native level) and strong English proficiency

Who you are

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with strong ownership mentality
  • Deep understanding of internet culture and trends in Brazil
  • Creative thinker with strong execution ability
  • Comfortable balancing strategy and hands-on work
  • Adaptable, fast-moving, and results-driven

Extra Points if you...

  • Passion for film, entertainment, or online communities
  • Experience with short-form video content (TikTok, Reels, etc.)
  • Background in startups or fast-scaling products
  • Familiarity with subscription-based or community-driven platforms

Our Culture

As Peliplat evolves into a global, product-driven company, our culture is not just something we believe in; it’s how we execute.

We are building more than a platform; we are shaping the home of movie buffs and redefining cinema as a shared, interactive experience . This requires a team that thinks beyond traditional models, moves with urgency, and creates value through both creativity and strategy.

Our culture is rooted in people who don’t just operate within systems, but who build, challenge, and scale them .

  • Ownership — Think Like a Builder

description:

A NCS Partners é líder em serviços profissionais de supply chain e parceira Platinum de consultoria da Manhattan Associates. Fundada em 2011 por uma equipe de liderança com mais de 25 anos de experiência com a Manhattan Associates, a NCSP cresceu para uma empresa global entregando resultados transformadores nas principais plataformas Manhattan — iSeries, Open Systems e Manhattan Active. Sobre a Vaga

Você trabalhará diretamente com clientes para entender seus fluxos de transporte, desenhar soluções dentro da plataforma Manhattan TMS, e garantir entregas bem-sucedidas por meio de configuração, testes, treinamento e suporte ao go-live.

• Orientar clientes no desenho de processos de negócio, configuração de sistema, testes funcionais e gestão de mudança em implantações de TMS.

• Colaborar estreitamente com membros internos e externos da equipe de projeto para garantir entregas dentro do prazo.

• Atuar como especialista (SME) em processos de gerenciamento de transporte, tarifação de frete, otimização de rotas, planejamento de cargas e gestão de transportadoras.

• Viajar para sites de clientes conforme necessário (estimativa de 20–40%, dependendo dos requisitos do projeto).Viajar para sites de clientes conforme necessário (estimativa de 20–40%, dependendo dos requisitos do projeto).

Requisitos 

• Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Logística, Supply Chain ou área correlata.

• Conhecimento dos conceitos de gerenciamento de transporte: tarifação de frete, planejamento de rotas, otimização de cargas, seleção de transportadoras, execução de embarques e liquidação (settlement).

• Familiaridade com SQL para consultas e troubleshooting básico.

• Fortes habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal em português e inglês.

• Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa em equipes multifuncionais e multiculturais. 

• Disponibilidade para viagens nacionais e internacionais conforme necessidade dos projetos.

Diferenciais

• Experiência com tecnologias de integração (APIs, EDI, middleware), incluindo o uso de POSTMAN ou similar. 

• Familiaridade com módulos Manhattan relacionados como WMS, OMS ou Supply Chain Planning.

• Experiência prévia em consultoria em empresas de serviços profissionais.

• Experiência em implementações na América Latina.

• Conhecimento de regulamentações brasileiras de transporte, frameworks tributários (ICMS, tributação de frete) e práticas logísticas locais.

O Que Oferecemos

title: Security BISO/PMO
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!

Buscamos: Security BISO/PMO

Resumo:

O Security BISO/PMO atua como um elo estratégico entre as unidades de tecnologia, negócio e a organização de cibersegurança. Essa função garante que as iniciativas de segurança estejam alinhadas aos objetivos do negócio, enquanto gerencia a entrega de projetos de segurança em toda a empresa. O profissional será responsável por conduzir a governança, priorizar demandas de segurança e supervisionar planos e execução de projetos para reduzir riscos e impulsionar o crescimento do negócio.

Responsabilidades:

Alinhamento com o Negócio:

  • Servir como ponto de contato principal para as unidades de negócio em relação às necessidades e iniciativas de cibersegurança.
  • Traduzir requisitos de negócio em estratégias e soluções de segurança acionáveis junto às demais equipes de cibersegurança.
  • Defender a segurança nos processos de negócio, garantindo conformidade com padrões regulatórios e organizacionais.

Gestão de Programas e Projetos:

  • Liderar e gerenciar o portfólio de projetos de segurança, garantindo entrega dentro do escopo, prazo e orçamento.
  • Desenvolver e manter planos de projeto, registros de riscos e relatórios de status para as partes interessadas.
  • Coordenar equipes multifuncionais, incluindo TI, segurança e stakeholders de negócio, para atingir os objetivos dos projetos.

Governança e Relatórios:

  • Estabelecer e manter estruturas de governança para programas de segurança.
  • Acompanhar e reportar indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) e métricas relacionadas às iniciativas de segurança.
  • Garantir alinhamento com requisitos de gestão de riscos corporativos e conformidade.

Gestão de Riscos:

  • Identificar, avaliar e priorizar riscos de segurança que impactam as operações do negócio e alinhar com o registro de riscos do GRC.
  • Colaborar com líderes de negócio para implementar estratégias de mitigação de riscos.

Engajamento com Stakeholders:

  • Comunicar-se de forma eficaz com executivos, líderes de negócio e equipes técnicas.
  • Fornecer atualizações regulares sobre postura de segurança, progresso dos projetos e ameaças emergentes.

Requisitos técnicos e experiência:

  • Graduação em Segurança da Informação, Ciência da Computação, Administração de Empresas ou área relacionada.
  • Mais de 7 anos em funções de cibersegurança, gestão de riscos ou gestão de projetos de segurança.
  • Forte conhecimento de frameworks de cibersegurança (NIST, ISO 27001, etc.).
  • Alta proficiência e experiência prática com metodologias de gestão de projetos, planejamento e entrega, como PMBOK e Agile.
  • Excelente comunicação e capacidade de influenciar e interagir com stakeholders seniores.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de gestão de projetos ou produtos.
  • Conhecimento avançado das ferramentas do Office.
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e de elaboração de relatórios para suporte à entrega de KPIs.
  • Fluência em inglês.

Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Certificações de segurança como CISSP, CompTIA Security+, CySA+, ISO 27001, ITILv3+ ou similares.
  • Certificações em gestão de projetos ou gestão de produtos.
  • Espanhol será um diferencial.

O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:

title: SAO PAULO - [HYBRID] - L2 SOC Analyst
description:
About the Company:

As the founding entity of RAINBOW PARTNERS, Quanteam is a consulting firm specializing in Banking, Finance, and Financial Services. Guided by our core values of closeness, teamwork, diversity, and excellence, our team of 1,000 expert consultants, representing 35 different nationalities, collaborates across 10 international offices: Paris, Lyon, New York, Montreal, London, Brussels, Geneva, Lisbon, Porto, and Casablanca.

We are currently seeking a seasoned Security Analyst (L2) to support one of our clients, a leading international financial institution headquartered in Montreal.

Role Overview:

As a Senior SOC Analyst embedded within a 24x7 Security Operations Center, you will be at the forefront of identifying, analyzing, and neutralizing sophisticated cyber threats targeting critical business infrastructure. Beyond routine alert handling, this role focuses on in-depth forensic investigation, proactive threat hunting, and the continuous strengthening of the SOC’s detection and response capabilities. The analyst in this position serves as a technical anchor for the team, guiding junior colleagues and actively contributing to the organization’s overall security posture.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Threat Detection & Incident Response

  • Ownership: Take the lead on high-severity and complex security events, including intrusions involving persistent adversaries, multi-stage attack chains, and advanced malicious payloads.
  • Investigation: Conduct thorough technical analysis across SIEM platforms, endpoint telemetry, and network traffic data to reconstruct attack timelines and uncover root causes.
  • Escalation Support: Serve as the primary escalation point for junior analysts, offering technical validation, investigative direction, and remediation guidance.
  • Documentation: Ensure all incidents, findings, and response actions are precisely recorded in case management systems to support operational continuity and post-event reviews.

2. Detection Engineering & Threat Hunting

  • Content Development: Design, tune, and maintain detection logic, correlation rules, and monitoring dashboards within SIEM platforms to maximize coverage and reduce alert noise.
  • Proactive Hunting: Initiate hypothesis-driven threat hunt campaigns using intelligence feeds, behavioral baselines, and knowledge of adversary tactics drawn from recognized attack frameworks.
  • Automation: Develop and maintain scripts and tooling (Python, Bash) to accelerate investigative workflows, automate data enrichment, and streamline repetitive SOC tasks.

3. Cross-functional Collaboration & SOC Development

  • Teamwork: Partner with adjacent teams (infrastructure, cloud, identity management, incident response) during active security events and broader remediation efforts.
  • Lessons Learned: Actively contribute to post-incident retrospectives, generating actionable recommendations to strengthen security controls and refine processes.
  • Continuous Improvement: Support tooling upgrades, SOC maturity initiatives, and security projects to keep operational capabilities in step with an evolving threat landscape.

Required Qualifications and Skills:

  • A minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in a SOC environment or a comparable senior cybersecurity role.
  • Demonstrated expertise with SIEM platforms (e.g., Splunk, ELK), including the authoring of queries, correlation rules, and custom dashboards.
  • Advanced understanding of security technologies spanning network defense (firewalls, IDS/IPS, proxies, VPN), endpoint protection (EDR/XDR), and data security solutions.
  • Solid grounding in incident response lifecycle, log analysis techniques, and packet capture (PCAP) examination.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of core networking protocols and architectures (OSI model, TCP/IP, DNS, SMTP).
  • Thorough understanding of attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures, with practical familiarity with frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Hands-on experience in both Windows and Linux environments, including the ability to identify indicators of compromise and abnormal system behavior.
  • Proficiency in scripting (Python, Bash) applied to investigation support and process automation.
  • A proactive, adversarial mindset with a continuous drive toward improved threat detection and defense.

Working conditions:

  • Candidate must be located or willing to relocate to Brazil (São Paulo)
  • Hybrid schedule with 3 days on-site per week
  • Participation in on-call rotations and extended coverage hours required
  • Availability for morning or daytime shifts, including weekend assignments as part of 24/7 operations
  • Fluency in English required

title: Data Engineer (Azure/Databricks)
description:
We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer to design, build, and scale modern data solutions using Azure Databricks. In this role, you will own the end-to-end development of data pipelines, drive best practices in data architecture, and ensure high-quality, reliable data is delivered to support analytics and business decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines and analytics solutions on Azure Databricks, ensuring alignment with lakehouse architecture and medallion design patterns
  • Design and implement end-to-end ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from diverse sources, transform it based on business requirements, and deliver it to downstream consumers
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain Apache Spark and PySpark jobs to efficiently process large-scale datasets
  • Implement data quality frameworks, validation processes, and monitoring/alerting systems to ensure data accuracy, reliability, and availability
  • Drive best practices by developing reusable frameworks, libraries, and standardized approaches for data engineering across the team
  • Optimize query performance and resource utilization within Azure environments to ensure cost efficiency and scalability
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of data pipelines, workflows, and architecture while ensuring compliance with security and governance policies
  • Participate in code reviews, CI/CD processes, and promote engineering excellence within the data organization

Need to Haves

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering, including at least 2+ years working with Azure Databricks and Apache Spark
  • Strong programming skills in Python and PySpark, along with advanced SQL (especially Spark SQL)
  • Proven experience building configuration-driven ETL pipelines and orchestrating workflows using tools such as Azure Data Factory, Databricks Workflows, or Apache Airflow
  • Solid understanding of data modeling concepts, including dimensional modeling and data vault methodologies
  • Hands-on experience with Delta Lake and lakehouse/medallion architecture patterns
  • Experience with Azure services including Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL Database, REST APIs, SFTP, and Azure Key Vault
  • Proficiency in Git for version control, including branching strategies, pull requests, and collaborative development workflows
  • Experience with CI/CD practices for deploying and managing data pipelines
  • Fluent English to interact with international teams

Nice to Haves

  • Experience working with large-scale distributed data systems and performance optimization techniques
  • Familiarity with data quality, testing, and observability frameworks
  • Experience supporting analytics or data science teams with curated and accessible datasets
  • Exposure to multi-cloud or hybrid cloud data environments

title: Lead Test Engineer
description:
Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Europe - Romania, Poland, and Ukraine, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.

Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past three years and plans to continue growing.

Key responsibilities

  • Demonstrate a deep, system-level understanding of the entire product architecture to ensure comprehensive and thorough testing across all layers.
  • Proactively identify, coordinate, and manage cross-team dependencies to ensure seamless end-to-end quality and delivery.
  • Employ extensive testing experience across Native Mobile Applications, Backend services, and Front-end systems .
  • Design and execute advanced testing techniques, including thorough Monkey Testing , and champion the introduction of Chaos Engineering practices into the development pipeline.
  • Identify tasks/dependencies/risks during backlog grooming/planning.
  • Provide reasonable test estimates and feedback on priorities.
  • Fully understand and actively provide ways to improve project/solution level test strategy/test design principles.
  • Contribute to the evaluation of testing tools/techniques/strategies.
  • Contribute effectively to the development of a project's test strategy and automation suite.
  • Collaborate with developers/business analysts for feedback into software design and tests.
  • Assist with effective test reporting and contribute to ensuring the CI/CD pipeline has thorough test coverages.
  • Contribute effectively to utilize an automation framework for testing and the creation of test scripts (different automation test layers such as UI or API Acceptance Tests).
  • Identify gaps in the current automation suite and help prioritize those / get them into the backlog.
  • Investigate and assist in diagnosing issues.
  • Share testing/product knowledge with other team members.

Must have

  • 5+ years of professional experience in Quality Assurance or Software Testing, with a focus on large, complex, and distributed systems.
  • Proven experience as a coordinator or leader managing QA activities across multiple, interdependent teams and technical domains (Mobile, Web, Backend).
  • Deep expertise in various testing methodologies, including mandatory experience with Monkey Testing and/or a strong theoretical or practical background in Chaos Engineering/Resilience Testing.
  • Mandatory professional experience testing: Native Mobile Applications (iOS and/or Android), Distributed Backend/Microservices Platforms.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms, preferably AWS, and understanding of how cloud services (e.g., EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS) impact system testing.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • Professional experience in complex frontend web applications.
  • Automation is a plus; experience programming or scripting in at least one modern language (e.g., Python or Ruby).

What we offer

  • 100% remote in Poland, Romania, Ukraine, or Brazil.
  • B2B Contract.
  • English classes.

A LiuGong Latin America (LGLA) foi fundada no Brasil em 2008 e é uma subsidiária integral do Grupo LiuGong. Desde 2015 fabricando equipamentos no país, a LiuGong vem crescendo nos mercados brasileiro e latino-americano.

O negócio abrange a venda e manutenção de equipamentos e acessórios para máquinas de construção, soluções de financiamento, treinamento de clientes, consultoria técnica e outros escopos. Entre os principais produtos estão carregadeiras de rodas, escavadeiras, motoniveladoras, rolos compactadores, retroescavadeiras, caminhões rígidos e plataformas aéreas de trabalho.

Além disso, a LiuGong continua expandindo sua estrutura com fábrica e centro de treinamento em Mogi Guaçu, além de escritórios em Campinas e Belo Horizonte, fortalecendo seu time e ampliando seu portfólio de soluções.

Para saber mais, visite:

Este espaço foi criado para que profissionais interessados em fazer parte da LiuGong possam cadastrar seu currículo, mesmo que não haja uma vaga específica aberta no momento.

Ao se candidatar, seu perfil ficará em nosso banco e poderá ser considerado para futuras oportunidades em diversas áreas, como: administrativa, comercial, engenharia, operações, supply chain, entre outras.

Buscamos profissionais com perfil proativo, orientados a resultados, que queiram se desenvolver em um ambiente dinâmico e multicultural.

Se você se identifica com a nossa empresa e deseja crescer com a gente, queremos te conhecer!

O nível de inglês poderá variar conforme a posição.

title: Supervisor de Importação e Exportação
description:
A Brink’s é uma empresa líder global em gestão de numerário e valores, soluções digitais para o varejo e serviços gerenciados de ATM.

Nossos clientes incluem instituições financeiras, varejistas, órgãos governamentais, casas da moeda, joalherias e outras operações comerciais. Nossa rede de operações em 51 países atende clientes em mais de 100 países.

Acreditamos na construção de parcerias que protegem o comércio, e isso exige fomentar uma cultura engajada que valorize pessoas com diferentes origens, ideias e perspectivas.

Construímos um senso de pertencimento, para que todos os colaboradores se sintam respeitados, seguros e valorizados, e oferecemos igualdade de oportunidades para participação e crescimento.

Como pessoa Supervisora de Importação e Exportação você será responsável por liderar e garantir toda a documentação necessária para os embarques nos processos de importação e exportação, cumprindo prazos e especificações dos órgãos legais e conforme determinação contratual.

Responsabilidades

  • Supervisionar diariamente no sistema da Receita Federal a existência de novos pedidos de embarque, acionando as áreas envolvidas e tomando as medidas necessárias;
  • Supervisionar o time quanto à documentação emitida a fim de evitar embarques incorretos;
  • Manter contato permanente com clientes externos e internos (nacional e internacional), avaliando a necessidade de correções de documentos e providenciando-os, a fim de manter os padrões exigidos pela legislação evitando penalidades e multas perante as alfândegas brasileira e do exterior;
  • Manter contato com o departamento de controle das filiais a fim de acompanhar as coletas (exportação) e entregas (importação) e posicionar Brink's e clientes quanto aos embarques cuja contratação é "porta a porta";
  • Supervisionar atividades administrativas como conferências e pagamento de frete aéreo internacional e valores a serem faturados;
  • Conhecer e interpretar os Inconterms (negociações entre importador e exportador) e providenciar instruções de emissão de documentos de acordo com o Incoterm negociado;
  • Seguir procedimentos internos de segurança e sigilo da informação;
  • Manter o cliente devidamente informado de todos os passos/acontecimentos do processo;
  • Participar dos programas de melhoria contínua e disseminar novas propostas de processos junto ao time.

Desafios

  • Garantir que os processos de importação e exportação ocorram de maneira correta e eficaz, providenciando todos os documentos necessários para embarque para exportação e conferência na importação, cumprindo os prazos estabelecidos e evitando penalidades e sanções.

title: Senior QA Analyst - Live Games
description:
We're looking for a talented and detail-obsessed Senior Quality Assurance Analyst to join Wildlife's Quality Assurance team, focused on our Live Games portfolio.

As a Senior QA Analyst, you will be responsible for estimating, planning, and executing test cases across our live titles — evaluating risks and impact, defining quality strategy, and helping the team grow through knowledge sharing. You will communicate testing demands and quality metrics to both developers and other analysts, owning the bridge between QA and engineering.

This role starts with broad coverage across all Wildlife live games, with the longer-term path of migrating into a single high-impact title as ownership deepens. Professional posture, sharp communication, and influence skills are essential - even though this is not a people-management role, you will interact across multiple disciplines and seniority levels.

The right person for this position is curious by nature, comfortable in a "take the initiative" environment, loves solving problems, and thrives in a fast-paced live operations context where every build matters.

What You'll Do

  • Execute manual testing with a meticulous eye across Wildlife's live games portfolio, ensuring every build meets our quality bar before reaching millions of daily players.
  • Own the end-to-end bug flow: identify, reproduce, write clear bug reports, prioritize based on impact, and decide whether issues go to backlog or require immediate fix.
  • Write, refine, and continuously optimize test cases - leveraging AI tools (Cursor, LLMs) to accelerate case creation and improve description quality at scale.
  • Apply AI-assisted build analysis: compare build A vs build B by analyzing code diffs (via Cursor), identifying changed files, and using structured prompts to surface high-risk areas before testing begins.
  • Hunt corner cases - go beyond the happy path to find edge scenarios that no one else catches, before players do.
  • Deploy builds on physical devices (iOS and Android), validating real-world behavior, performance, and UX.
  • Monitor and analyze post-release quality using Firebase, Crashlytics, and internal QA tooling (QA Hub).
  • Define and evolve quality metrics that engineering and product use to make decisions - not just report them.
  • Collaborate directly with engineering on debugging, prioritization, and release decisions.
  • Provide your team with a quality strategy that supports delivery goals and aligns with Wildlife's overall quality strategy.
  • Advocate for user experience and game quality across product, design, and engineering conversations.
  • Participate as one of the first analysts on new game projects when needed - helping new dev teams establish quality processes and standards from the ground up.

What You'll Need

  • University degree in computing-related fields (Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Systems Analysis and Development) - or equivalent practical experience.
  • Previous professional experience in software development or game testing, with at least 2 consecutive years in mobile games or high-cadence live operations environments.
  • Strong understanding of computer science fundamentals: data structures, networking, concurrency, memory management, and algorithm analysis.
  • Solid command of software testing concepts: testability, escape rate, regression, unit, integration, soak, stress, and test automation.
  • Demonstrated experience with Firebase, Crashlytics, or equivalent crash analytics and monitoring tooling in production environments.
  • Track record of writing, structuring, and optimizing test cases with method - not just executing scripts written by others.
  • Proven ability to identify non-obvious corner cases, with concrete examples of critical bugs you found that others missed.
  • Hands-on experience deploying and validating builds on physical iOS and Android devices.
  • Active use of AI in your QA workflow - Cursor, ChatGPT, Copilot, or equivalent tools applied to code analysis, test case generation, or debugging.
  • Clear technical communication - you can speak the developer's language without losing the quality lens.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with live games at scale (millions of DAU).
  • Track record of creating quality metrics that were adopted by engineering teams.
  • Familiarity with Unity, C#, or mobile-native stacks.
  • Experience with mobile test automation (Appium, XCTest, Espresso) - even though this role is primarily manual.
  • Understanding of DevOps tools such as Chef, Ansible, Jenkins, or similar.

More About You

  • You're passionate about games and about software development - and you know how to ensure its quality.
  • You thrive in agile environments and stimulate that mindset in your team.
  • You're creative when solving problems and continuously seek improvements in processes and solutions.
  • You communicate clearly with your team and the broader company to identify issues and align demands.
  • You have the autonomy to recognize current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes on the final result.
  • You are professionally postured and exercise influence even outside of formal leadership roles - knowing how to interact with multiple disciplines and higher job levels with credibility.

How We Work

This role is hybrid, with 3 days per week in our Itaim Bibi office (São Paulo). The in-person time is a deliberate accelerator for pair debugging, faster decisions with engineering, and high-bandwidth alignment. The remaining 2 days are remote.

About Wildlife

Wildlife is one of the leading mobile game developers and publishers in the world. We have released more than 60 titles, reaching billions of people around the globe. Today, we have offices in Brazil, Argentina, Ireland, and the United States. Here, we create games that will excite, intrigue, and engage our players for years to come.

Equal Opportunity

Wildlife is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, colour, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law.

We're committed to providing accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process.
